title: German Startup Isar’s Rocket Lifts Off on European Space Mission
description: An Isar Aerospace rocket lifted off from a launchpad in Norway as the German startup seeks to pull off the first commercial space mission to reach orbit from continental Europe.

title: Apple Bets on Foldable iPhone Under New CEO
description: Apple CEO John Ternus is preparing for his first major product event since succeeding Tim Cook, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the September 9 launch. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Hardware Analyst Woo Jin Ho joins Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend and says Ternus’ engineering background could bring renewed focus to hardware and expanding Apple’s ecosystem as smartphone upgrades become increasingly incremental. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: TCS Plans One-Gigawatt Capacity Data Center in Southern India
description: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. on Saturday said its HyperVault unit and partners have committed 700 billion rupees ($7.4 billion) to set up a large-scale artificial intelligence data center campus in southern India, speeding up its push into an area that Indian tech firms are prioritizing for future growth.
